Connect AI assistants to Fundraise Up with MCP
You can now connect an AI assistant to Fundraise Up with the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Connect an assistant such as Claude or ChatGPT, and you can ask about your account in plain language instead of exporting data or querying the API yourself.
An Organization Administrator turns MCP on in Settings, then anyone in your organization can connect their own assistant. The assistant reads only what your Dashboard role can see — donations, recurring plans, campaigns, designations, and fundraising totals. Access is read-only, so an assistant can read your data but never create, change, or delete anything.
Learn more about Fundraise Up MCP →
